designed_relationships: workflow version 2 (published 2025-10-01, 60 % of later cases) removes the verify_identity handoff and adds a parallel collect_address_proof step: about 35 % lower active elapsed time and about 20 % fewer handoffs per case than version 1 (synthetic).
enterprise organizations have about 2x the rework rate: identity_proof rejection probability 0.20 vs 0.11 (synthetic).

region reg-north has longer customer waiting: more customer_info_requested / external_verification pauses per case (mean 1.65 vs 0.9) and each about 1.4x longer, so paused_time_hours is highest (synthetic).
bottleneck at step approve_account for reviewer rev-004: 40 % of reviews, queue x3.6 and review x3.4 slower than rev-005 / rev-006 (synthetic).

injections.description: 2 cases completed with a required document missing: case-000218 has no business_registration version; case-000545 has a business_registration version that was never accepted.
injections.expected_handling: ingest rejects each case and every row hanging off it with MISSING_REQUIRED_DOCUMENT; raw rows are kept; none enters the population.

injections.description: 2 pairs of conflicting decisions on one step version: an approval followed 7 minutes later by a 'rejected' decision from another reviewer, no version number.
injections.expected_handling: ingest keeps the earlier decision and rejects the later approval row with DECISION_CONFLICT (only that row); the replay events show the same conflict through approve-step.

injections.description: 3 customer_info_requested pauses that lie wholly outside every working interval (a Saturday, a Sunday and a weekday holiday) inside completed cases.
injections.expected_handling: the pipeline accepts them, deducts 0 business hours and returns a PAUSE_OUTSIDE_WORKING_INTERVAL flag for each.

injections.description: an attempted edit of the published workflow version wfv-001 (publish again; a direct UPDATE of a step definition).
injections.expected_handling: 409 ALREADY_PUBLISHED; the UPDATE is refused by the immutability trigger.

injections.description: a draft version wfv-003 whose dependencies form a cycle (sd-901 -> sd-902 -> sd-903 -> sd-901); it is not in the entity files because the seed would reject it.
2 resubmissions that would overwrite an accepted document version (resubmit-document on an accepted type; a direct UPDATE of a document_versions row).
injections.expected_handling: resubmit-document is refused with NOT_IN_CHANGES_REQUESTED; the UPDATE is refused by the append-only trigger; the prior row stays intact.

injections.description: 2 reassignments that drop the prior assignment interval instead of closing it.
injections.expected_handling: reassign-work is an extension command (501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED now); when it ships the prior interval must be closed with ended_at, never deleted.

injections.description: 2 of the 6 holidays fall on a weekend (2026-02-14 Saturday, 2026-07-04 Saturday).
injections.expected_handling: a holiday on a weekend subtracts nothing from the working set.

injections.description: 3 customer waits labelled as work: reason_code internal_processing / document_review / manual_check with pause_requested true.
injections.expected_handling: ingest rejects each case and its rows with PAUSE_REASON_NOT_CONFIGURED.

injections.description: 2 self-approvals: the approve_account reviewer was also the last assignee of the step.
injections.expected_handling: ingest rejects each case and its rows with SELF_APPROVAL.

injections.description: a reopen of a completed case.
injections.expected_handling: reopen-case is refused with 409 CASE_REOPEN_FORBIDDEN; a linked correction case is opened with create-case (corrects_case_id).

injections.description: a workflow migration whose step mapping drops an accepted document.
injections.expected_handling: migrate-workflow is an extension command (501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED now); accepted documents must be carried by document_type, never dropped.
